summary.scope_caveat: SYNTHETIC development fixture; not official data or verified savings. Product results will describe a four-month workload sample.

opportunities.title: Idle interactive sessions (synthetic)
opportunities.action: Pilot a warning and idle timeout with an opt-out
opportunities.method: Synthetic scenario: reclaim 4–10 GPU-hours at the sample rate of $2.50/GPU-hour. These are stored fixture values, not backend calculations.
opportunities.basis: Synthetic low-utilization session evidence; cancellation alone is not evidence of recoverable waste.
caveats: Synthetic development fixture, not verified savings.
Low utilization alone cannot establish that work is unnecessary.
Missing measurements remain unknown; real results cover the four-month sample.

cost_if_wrong.description: An idle timeout may interrupt useful interactive work; synthetic risk range only.
cost_if_wrong.mitigation: Warn first, allow opt-out, pilot on a small cohort, and disable the timeout if useful work is interrupted.

findings.description: Synthetic telemetry has two low-utilization samples. This does not by itself establish recoverability.
